messages.subject: color does not work
parts:
Hi ggplot users,

Whenever I set a color to a single plot, it does not work. 

For example, 
disq1 =  ggplot(data=dataframe,aes(x=time,y=variableA))+geom_point(aes(colour='blue'))

So it just plots the time series of variable A. However, the color is red no matter what color I set. If let the geom_point() be default, it is black color. What is the problem? Thanks for your help.

messages.author: 98fc74ba56643c44
messages.subject: Re: color does not work
parts:
Hi,

If you want to set the `color` as a single value, you should place it
outside of `aes()`

try this instead:

ggplot(data=dataframe,aes(x=time,y=variableA))+geom_point(colour='blue')

You put the `color` inside `aes()` if you want to have color be
automatically assigned depending on the value of a factor or continuous
variable, for example:

ggplot(...)j + geom_color(aes(color=gender))

if gender is a variable/column in your dataframe.

S
